manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through its peak with a ball dropped from rest at that same instant.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes showing vertical position, velocity, and acceleration of a tossed ball and a released ball. At the apex, velocity is zero, but gravity acceleration remains constant.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
